outcome: Rate of hysterectomy and/or hypogastric artery ligation
cohort: Fourteen patients treated in a tertiary hospital between July 2010 and February 2015 for intractable postpartum haemorrhage due to uterine atony, after medical treatment and single B-Lynch sutures had failed.
finding: The double B-Lynch suture effectively controlled bleeding in all 14 patients and appears to be an effective, reliable solution for intractable postpartum haemorrhage without unfavorable impacts on fertility.
